title: Design System: 橘伴 Desktop AI Pet

title.purpose: 展开面板标题、空态标题、卡片标题。

label.purpose: 作者名、时间戳、工具条、计数。

shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: 消息气泡与带框图标按钮的奶油鼓起感。

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: 外壳级环境投影，仅框架使用。

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: 面板入场与状态过渡的标准缓动；禁止回弹。

motion.name: ease-ui
motion.purpose: 按钮按压与页内内容位移。

components.name: Send Button
components.description: 面板唯一主操作，焦糖橘渐变，hover 加深一档。
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="发送消息"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z"/><path d="M22 2 11 13"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #bd7145, #a45831); border: 1px solid rgba(192, 108, 60, 0.22); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 3px 7px rgba(174, 91, 42, 0.14), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 231, 208, 0.4); transition: transform 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-send:hover { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #b1673c, #96502d); } .ds-send:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a45831; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 带框暖白瓷砖，面板头部唯一图标按钮语言（展开 44px / 紧凑 33px）。
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" type="button" aria-label="设置"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="19" height="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3m0 14v3M2 12h3m14 0h3M5 5l2 2m10 10 2 2M19 5l-2 2M7 17l-2 2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; color: #796959; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fffefa, #fcf7ef); border: 1px solid #eadfd4; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 2px 5px rgba(126,79,40,0.04); transition: background 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-icon:hover { color: #a3653f; border-color: rgba(203, 168, 136, 0.45); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fffaf1, #f9ecdc); } .ds-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a45831; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quick Prompt Chip
components.description: 快捷提问：单一暖白胶囊，不再逐个着色。
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; color: #695345; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #fffdf8, #fcf6ee); border: 1px solid rgba(197, 171, 145, 0.36); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(93, 61, 39, 0.05); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(181, 133, 92, 0.52); background: linear-gradient(160deg, #fffaf1, #faf0e3); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a45831; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Capsule
components.description: 面板内输入统一为胶囊语言；行内编辑器用 12px 圆角变体。
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="记录一项待办…" />
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; color: #493b31; background: #fffdf9; border: 1px solid rgba(172, 144, 122, 0.45); border-radius: 999px; caret-color: #a45831; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #796959; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(165, 106, 72, 0.65); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(165, 106, 72, 0.1); }

components.name: Assistant Bubble
components.description: 助手消息气泡：奶油渐变面 + 暖描边 + 低位柔影，小角指向猫头像。
components.html: 好的，我看了看你的待办列表，周五之前有三件事。
components.css: .ds-bubble { max-width: 320px; padding: 12px 15px; color: #493b31; background: linear-gradient(165deg, #fffefa, #fdf8f0); border: 1px solid rgba(155, 120, 94, 0.22); border-radius: 18px 18px 18px 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(92, 61, 41, 0.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Pin Badge
components.description: 置顶状态徽章：纯指示器，不是按钮。
components.css: .ds-pin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; color: #96755a; background: rgba(255, 241, 226, 0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(203, 168, 136, 0.5); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); }

narrative.northStar: 奶油糖壳里的猫（The Cream Shell）
narrative.overview: 一体 SVG 奶油渐变外壳是视觉权威；面板内部延续同一套暖调奶油材质。密度偏松弛，控件安静、圆角柔软、动效指数缓出，唯一允许喧闹的是猫本身。已确认拒绝：彩虹糖果色 chip、回弹缓动、面向用户的技术词汇、裸色 3px 侧边条。
keyCharacteristics: 奶油渐变材质从外壳贯穿到内部
一套控件语言：带框图标按钮 + 胶囊输入 + 单一强调色
空状态由白猫帧资产出场

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: 强调橘在任何一屏占比 ≤10%；次要操作一律暖白底 + 棕字。

rules.name: The Warm Gray Rule
rules.body: 次级文字从暖棕取色（--muted-soft），禁用中性灰。

rules.name: The Declare-Elevation-Once Rule
rules.body: 细暖描边 + 低位柔影 + 内高光各司其职，不叠出幽灵卡片。

dos: 新增面板内表面延续奶油渐变叙事
错误文案面向用户，原始错误进 console
动效用 cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 指数缓出
donts: 不给 chip/卡片逐个上彩虹色
不用回弹缓动（宠物回复气泡是已记录豁免）
不把状态指示器做成按钮形态
不改白猫三帧资产与外壳几何
